subject: [PATCH v5 2/3] mm: swap: drop dropbehind swap cache folios on writeback completion

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Linux kernel's swap handling to drop PG_dropbehind folios from the swap cache immediately after writeback completion, rather than waiting for reclaim to find them later. This change is similar to how file folios are handled and ensures that swap cache folios are properly cleaned up when they are no longer needed. The patch adds a new function `swap_writeback_dropbehind_folio` to handle this task and modifies several other functions in the kernel's memory management code to use this new function.
